content.description: 计算24小时后细菌的数目
content.title: 幂运算

resolved.title: 幂运算
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你知道吗，你体内的细菌细胞比构成你身体的细胞还要多？神奇吧!

一个细菌培养液开始时有**500**个细菌，每经过一小时会增加一倍。
这意味着，1小时后，细菌的数量变为1000个，2小时后变为2000个，以此类推。

请写程序计算并输出**24**小时后培养液中的细菌数量。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Exponentiation[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Did you know that there are more bacteria cells in your body than cells that make up your body? Weird!

A bacteria culture starts with [b]500 [/b]bacteria and doubles in size every hour.
Which means, after 1 hour the number of bacteria is 1000, after 2 hours - 2000, and so on.

Let’s calculate and output the number of bacteria that will be in the culture after [b]24 [/b]hours.

[note]The formula to calculate the bacteria after N hours will be: [b]500*2ᴺ[/b][/note]
resolved.hint_md: 计算N小时后的细菌数的公式：**500*2ᴺ**
